style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#F9FAFB;strokeColor=#6B7280;spacing=8;rounded=1;arcSize=3;" value="<b>Networks</b> &nbsp; The Docker network edge joins nginx, backend, collector, trace-check and langfuse-web. Each project also has its own private network. langfuse-web and langfuse-worker both use postgres, clickhouse, redis and minio. <b>Secrets</b> are host files with mode 600 (backend.env, collector.env, check.env, langfuse.env), not in git. The VM has no external IP; SSH is through IAP only." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="1560" x="300" y="925" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Networks The Docker network edge joins nginx, backend, collector, trace-check and langfuse-web. Each project also has its own private network. langfuse-web and langfuse-worker both use postgres, clickhouse, redis and minio. Secrets are host files with mode 600 (backend.env, collector.env, check.env, langfuse.env), not in git. The VM has no external IP; SSH is through IAP only.
